chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ibn Bukayr, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, at the end of the last time I met him, about a boy who had not reached puberty and had intercourse with a woman, or committed fornication with a woman: what is to be done with them? He said: “The boy is beaten with less than the hadd punishment, and the hadd punishment is carried out upon the woman.”

I said: A slave-girl who has not reached puberty is found with a man committing fornication with her. He said: “The slave-girl is beaten with less than the hadd punishment, and the hadd punishment is carried out upon the man.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man involved in the act
key_terms.الْجَارِيَةُ: a young female slave-girl; here, a prepubescent girl
key_terms.الْحَدِّ: the prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.الْحُلُمَ: puberty; the stage at which legal accountability begins
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman involved in the act
key_terms.فَجَرَ: committed fornication or illicit sexual intercourse
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: is beaten; subjected to disciplinary striking

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on zina involving a boy or girl who has not reached puberty?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning illicit intercourse involving a minor who has not yet reached puberty. It states that the prepubescent minor receives disciplinary beating less than the hadd punishment, while the legally accountable adult party receives the hadd punishment.
